page: Microsoft Azure E32ds_v7 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the Edsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical Intel Xeon 6973P-C cores operating at 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It includes 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core CPU performance with a stress-ng score of 34203.68 and a PassMark CPU score of 48743.5. Memory bandwidth tests show 146.04 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 62.52 GB/sec for large-block writes. The system demonstrates strong single-threaded gzip compression performance at 36.05 GB/sec. In LLM inference tests, the server achieves a strong prompt processing speed of 190.8 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model, though text generation on a large 70B model drops to a weak 2.69 tokens/sec.

Given its high memory density and dedicated Intel Xeon compute resources, the E32ds_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound enterprise applications. The combination of 256 GB of RAM, local NVMe storage, and solid database benchmark results makes this server type highly suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and medium-scale AI inference workloads.
